goal: Run an authenticated analytics app with long background calculations

evidence.finding: Most routes are behind login; long background jobs are required

direct_check.finding: No existing app directly meets these product requirements

assumptions.claim: A maintainer can manage production PostgreSQL

alternatives.name: VPS and local PostgreSQL
alternatives.risk: Shared failure domain and operational burden
alternatives.reversal: Export and restore to external DB

horizons.consequence: Offsite recovery and isolation become critical

decision.reason: Needs named operator and tested backup recovery before approval
decision.invalidated_by: No operations ownership or inadequate recovery time
